title: Lamb Skewers with Roasted Vegetables
description: Tender lamb skewers served with a variety of roasted vegetables, perfect for a summer evening. The combination of herbs and spices adds a delicious flavor to this dish.

ingredients.name: Mixed vegetables (such as zucchini, bell peppers, onions)

instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together olive oil, garlic, lemon juice, salt, and black pepper. Add the lamb pieces and toss to coat.
Thread the lamb pieces onto the skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
Place the skewers on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Roast the lamb skewers in the preheated oven for 12-15 minutes, or until cooked through.
While the lamb is cooking, toss the mixed vegetables with olive oil, salt, and black pepper in a separate bowl.
Transfer the vegetables to a Dutch oven and roast in the oven for 15-20 minutes, or until tender.
Serve the lamb skewers with the roasted vegetables.
